plugins.name: deck-kit
plugins.description: Two-skill pipeline for presenter-grade HTML decks: deck-plan (source → reviewed slide plan) and deck-build (plan → Socratic per-slide HTML generation → 4 validation gates: static, tokens, HTTP smoke, Playwright visual). 24 slide archetypes across workshop / lecture / talk, frozen design-token system, keyboard nav + presenter mode, plain-HTML output served with a bundled Node static server.
